task.title: Log in to the Hospital Management System
task.shortdesc: Use your assigned credentials to sign in to the system.

taskbody.prereq: You must have a valid username and password provided by your organization.

step.cmd: Open the Hospital Management System login page.
step.info: The login page displays fields for your username and password.

step.cmd: Enter your username in the Username field.
Enter your password in the Password field.

taskbody.result: The system opens the main dashboard.
